name: nymrel-studio-hub
description: Local stdio access to Nymrel Studio's verified MCP utilities.

interface.longDescription: Runs a local wrapper around 15 Nymrel MCP tools and labels their real evidence limits. Several are templates, simulations, or process-local helpers; crawler and configured provider search can make external read requests. OpenUCP never settles payment. No Remote activation or credentials are included.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the local Nymrel Studio Hub tools when they match my request.
